name: Tara Mingledorff
subject: Reminder: Two evenings with Congressman Moore this month
disclaimer_text: paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
body:
Dear Peter,I wanted to follow up on my recent note about Congressman Tim Moore's two events in western North Carolina later this month. Both evenings are coming together beautifully, and we would love to have you with us.This is your opportunity to visit with the Congressman, catch up with friends who have stood with him, and hear directly from him about the work ahead to keep a strong Republican majority in the House. [](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-r/) **Reception hosted by Dr. Gregory and Mariska Berkley**
Tuesday, October 13 | 5:30 - 7:30 p.m.
623 Wilderness Road, Tryon, NC 28782
Attendee: $150 [SAVE MY SPOT IN TRYON](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-y/) [](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-j/) **2026 Campaign Fish Fry hosted by Maynard Bradley**
Thursday, October 15 | 5:00 - 6:30 p.m.
3253 Polkville Road, Shelby, NC 28150
Donations are appreciated but not required to attend. [PITCH IN FOR THE FISH FRY](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-i/) The support raised at these events helps carry the Congressman's message all the way through Election Day, and it means a great deal to him to see familiar faces in the room.To RSVP, email [RSVP@CastlebarStrategies.com](mailto:RSVP@CastlebarStrategies.com) or simply reply to this message. **If you can't make it but would like to contribute, checks payable to Friends of Tim Moore may be mailed to PO Box 97275, Raleigh, NC 27624.** We hope to see you in Tryon, Shelby, or both!With gratitude,Tara Mingledorff
_Finance Director, Tim Moore_ [](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-d/)[](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-h/)[](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-k/)[](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-u/) This email was paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
PO BOX 97275 RALEIGH, NC 27624
[Privacy Policy](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-o/) | [Unsubscribe](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-u-fdrkylk-hkhielhuy-b/)
